issue: 422 error, Blotato says my Facebook connection expired. I manage pages for several clients in Business Manager.
reply: Your Facebook login inside Blotato has expired, so Blotato can't post there right now. Reconnect Facebook in Settings in the Blotato app. When Facebook asks which pages to allow, choose Opt in to all current and future Pages and grant every permission it lists, so the connection covers all your client pages. Then check Posts > Failed and resend anything that failed. Did the reconnect work?

issue: Posts keep failing with 90009 could not fetch the media. All my client photos are in one Google Drive folder.
reply: Blotato couldn't download the photo because the Drive link needs a sign-in. The quickest fix: set your whole client Drive folder's General access to Anyone with the link, so every file in it opens without a login, then use the direct-download form of each link (drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=FILE_ID&export=download). Then try the post again. Want me to convert one link for you?
